title: Minigame: A11.17 Stealth and Lax

source.basis: Manufactured under R0.3 as the minigame of the A11.17 claim (the Rules-first plan, section 7): Finnish squads advance into CC in woods against concealed Russians, their facts entered by hand.
source.legacy: None: a manufactured minigame (R0.3), adapting no legacy card
adaptation: A minimal card (ruling R22.3): who is Stealthy, Lax, or neither for the Ambush, Concealment, Search, and Search Casualties drs, asked on the Rule Workbench.

introduction: Elite and 1st Line Finns are Stealthy unless Lax (A11.17, A25.7): a Finnish squad advances into a woods Location held by a concealed Russian squad.

victoryConditions.text: A minigame has no victory: it proves its rules on the Rule Workbench and in play.
